basis: explicit revised scenario and dataset fields, not scenario IDs
automatic: exact declared booking count and booking fields
recorded confirmation and provider identity before booking where declared
declared earliest slot, ambiguity and correction state where supported
declared location/phone/hours facts and structured supported assertions
shared general offer/location, callback and next-step checks
every declared fault actually triggered; booking faults at write after consent
required_manual: every prose reply rule, note, forbidden statement, source-basis requirement and contract requirement
every unsupported expected or patient-fact field identified in preflight
accurate spoken location/referral answer; provider name is not required when explicitly waived
honest staff-directed next step; no unrecorded callback, transfer or follow-up
all substitute services declined when declared
patient-driver response fidelity and recovery questions not automatically supported
emergency escalation and requested human assistance
no wrong spoken claim, invented clinical fact or unrelated clinic phone
recovery quality after an actually triggered failure
adjudication: No pass while any required review is incomplete or any automatic assertion failed. An untriggered intended fault cannot pass recovery. Infrastructure failures and unsupported patient behavior are not silently relabeled agent failures or successes. Missing booking alone is not a false refusal; internal selection alone is not a spoken false claim. Source clarifications override conflicting older prose only as explicitly documented. No expectation changes after execution.
